pages.text: Can be used to make decorative lanterns and to make certain $(l:sin_alignments/herbal_sigils)Herbal Sigils$().
Dried herbs can be made from pounded herbs by using a Mystical Campfire.
Can be used on an $(l:utilities/incense_provider)Incense Provider$() to provide a positive status effect to surrounding entities within a radius of 10 metres.
